## Objetivo
Implement transactional play storage, validation and create/read APIs only. T14 owns history/leaderboard aggregation, persisted suggestion integration and play SSE publication coverage. T11 owns client delivery. This task does not require SSE or derived-data endpoints to exist.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] HTTP tests cover creating and retrieving plays, signed-out rejection using the existing authorization harness, real game/member references, duplicate/empty participants, optional finite scores including negative/zero, nonnumeric rejection, at least one winner and winners belonging to participants. Linked plays use the confirmed date and participants drawn from its attendee snapshot; ad hoc plays use explicit dates and group members. Reconfirmation does not rewrite stored play participants.
- [ ] Invalid data and an injected failure after partial participant/score/winner inserts roll back the entire play transaction. An independent reader sees complete records only after commit. Closing/reopening the isolated temporary database retains the same play, participant, score and winner records. Tests never use the development database. Container-restart evidence remains T12's responsibility.
- [ ] Deleting a game with recorded plays returns 409 with useful guidance and leaves records intact; unplayed-game deletion still works. npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass without derived-data, SSE or play-screen delivery.
